name: Chives
description: Clump-forming plants featuring slender, hollow grass-like green leaves and striking spherical pom-poms of purple blossoms.

img.alt: An illustration of Chives with slender green leaves and round purple flower heads
img.caption: Small flowers, plenty of character.

grow: Plant in an open, sunny spot or light partial shade.
Ensure soil is rich, fertile, and holds adequate moisture.
Divide clumps every few years to keep plants vigorous.
Snip leaves right down to the base to encourage fresh regrowth.
enjoy: Chop fresh green blades for bread and butter, eggs, potatoes.
Garnish salads and savory dishes with edible purple flower florets.
Grow neat borders along vegetable patches or pathways.
Provide early season nectar for visiting pollinators.
